buildCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm build; else pnpm install && pnpm build; fi
installCommand: npm i -g pnpm && if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend && pnpm install; else pnpm install; fi
devCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend && pnpm dev; else pnpm dev; fi
